arguments.sql: SELECT printf('%05d', ml.zip) AS zip_code, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'MA' AND ml.zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ml.zip ORDER BY txn_count DESC, ml.zip ASC LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: Finds the Massachusetts ZIP code with the most transactions, counting all transactions (labelled or not), and shows it as a five-digit text value.
assumptions: Counted all transactions regardless of fraud label, since the question asks about transaction volume.
Location is taken from the transaction's merchant location (merchant_location_id), with state = 'MA'.
Transactions whose location has a NULL ZIP were excluded.
ZIP is stored as an integer, so it was zero-padded to five digits (Massachusetts ZIPs begin with 0).
Ties, if any, are broken by the lower ZIP code.
